method: Independent stdlib half-plane clipping, shoelace areas, ear triangulation and signed triangle intersections; no application modules imported.

units.coordinates: campus metres rotated into retained study axes

rounding: raw retains floating-point calculation output; rounded displays six decimals. Neither precision represents measurement accuracy.

assumptions.targetInterpretation: Conditional internal-envelope benchmark, borrowed from the published 16.4m² average. It is not proof of the rental area, clear area or individual room dimensions.
assumptions.guardInterpretation: Geometric study guard only, not a legal or accessibility-compliance claim.
assumptions.internalPartitions: Bathroom, kitchenette and other internal partition footprints are unknown and are not deducted. The internal envelope is not certified usable floor area.

identifiability.explanation: The counts describe a simplified initial parameterization, not the remaining rank or degrees of freedom of the current constrained model. Resident alignments, inherited divider slopes, fixed ends, equal-bay interpolation, shared hall fronts and area targets fix or couple parameters. Exact residual rank would require an explicit parameter vector and independent constraint Jacobian. Area targets and equality are modeling assumptions, not measurements.
missingPhysicalEvidence: Stair length, landings and vertical construction

supersedingEvidence.note: The resident measured 2.72 m wall-to-wall, split into 1.43 m flight/guard and 1.29 m walkway, and confirmed two landing doors. This script reconstructs the old saved geometry; its dimensions are not a measurement-compliant replacement.

retainedMetadataNotIndependentlyRecomput.rawShellSectionMeaning: Copied for context from provenance. This script independently intersects the saved study plate and roof plan; it does not resection the complete 3D shell.

interpretation: Conditional internal envelopes omit unknown internal service-partition footprints.
A published category-average area does not constrain every individual room to that exact area.
Agreement with the category average is not independent validation because most rooms were fitted to that benchmark.
No geometry was changed, and no measured floor plan, physical room number, occupancy, or compliant route is asserted.

staircase.interpretation: A positive right-only shrink increases the L3 share. Flight insets are symbolic assumptions.

heights.interpretation: Difference between an exterior roof surface and an assumed floor plane; no slab deduction or clear-ceiling measurement.

unassigned.interpretation: Residual strip and connected pocket, with no established use or circulation function.

doorGraph.interpretation: This audits saved connectivity only. The resident has confirmed separate L and R doors onto the same landing; the missing R connection is an implementation omission, not missing topological evidence or a claim about actual exits.
